pr_title: backupccl: add IF NOT EXISTS as optional clause to CREATE SCHEDULE
pr_body:
The IF NOT EXISTS clause makes the CREATE SCHEDULE statement idempotent: if the
user already has scheduled a backup with the same label, we noop, regardless of
the destination of the backup. This feature eases the user's ability to use
CREATE SCHEDULE in automated scripts. Note: If the user adds the IF NOT EXISTS
clause without providing schedule label, the CREATE SCHEDULE query is invalid.

Fixes: #57892

Release Note (sql change): Added the optional IF NOT EXISTS clause to the CREATE
SCHEDULE statement, making the statment idempotent.

Release justification: low risk, high benefit changes to existing functionality

review_comments: can we add a one-liner comment saying that this checks if a schedule with the same label already exists.

In the Format method below, we need to add a clause to print `IF NOT EXISTS` if the bool is true. You can refer to `create.go` in this package for reference. Format is a pretty printer of the query and we expect the output of Format to be round-trippable in CRDB.
You also need to add few test cases in `pkg/sql/parser/testdata/create_schedule`
+1 to keeping ScheduleLabelSpec a simple struct.

I know there were some comments around the naming... and the confusion.
I would personally prefer `RequireUnique` field -- I think it conveys what this label means. You can describe that require unique is set when creating *new* schedules -- and that, as the name implies, it requires the label to be unique.

I don't feel too strongly about this though -- so if you think IfNotExists is a better name, then keep it.

Kept  IfNotExists because I think it makes the code a little easier read and it tightly couples the field to the IF NOT EXISTS clause. The field is only every evaluated to decide whether we should call the `checkLabelAlreadyExists` function and no op.

All exported structs and methods require a comment that starts with the exported name:

`ScheduleLabelSpec` describes the labelling specification for a scheduled job.
